faq.question: Does the Snaprint S1 work with my existing printer?
faq.answer: Yes. The Snaprint S1 works with any printer brand  --  Canon, HP, Epson, Brother  --  so you don't need to replace your existing equipment.

faq.question: Can the kiosk take orders when my shop is closed?
faq.answer: Yes. Orders queue automatically and the kiosk keeps printing whether or not you're present, so your shop can earn from print jobs placed after hours.

faq.question: What happens to a customer's uploaded documents?
faq.answer: Files are end-to-end encrypted and automatically deleted after each print job completes  --  no document is stored on the kiosk.

faq.question: How do shop owners track orders and revenue?
faq.answer: Every order, along with revenue, print counts, and ink and paper status, is visible on a live dashboard on the shop owner's phone.

faq.question: Can I get a refund if I cancel before installation?
faq.answer: Yes. If you've paid for a kiosk but installation hasn't taken place yet, you can cancel and request a full refund, processed within 7–14 business days to your original payment method.
